findings.issue: אֲשֶׁר + יִפֹּל + מִן + עָלָיו leaves the subject open: what falls, or the thing fallen upon. Spanish makes todo lo que the subject of both caer and se impurecerá, él a different participant, and desde locks מִן as ablative rather than part of the carcass.
findings.spanishSpan: todo lo que cayere desde el cadáver de ellos sobre él se impurecerá

findings.issue: יֻתָּץ is hophal imperfect 3ms with the compound subject oven + dual; serán derribados makes the verb plural.

notes: טְמֵאִים הֵם and וּטְמֵאִים יִהְיוּ לָכֶם are both kept; לָכֶם is ustedes.
